name: Aleph
description: Aleph lets agents query the financial data, reports, and models of the signed-in user's Aleph workspace. Each user signs in to their own Aleph account through the browser.

prompts.text: Explain the variance between budget and actuals for last quarter.
What is our monthly burn rate for the last six months?
Draft a summary of revenue and margin trends for the board pack.

apps.name: Aleph
apps.description: Financial data and report queries, over Aleph's MCP server with browser sign-in.
